situation: Coworker keeps DMing me on Slack about his fantasy football league while I'm trying to finish a deck due at 4. Nice guy, don't want to be rude.
reply: Ha, that trade is bold. I'm going heads-down on the board deck until 4, so I'll be quiet for a bit. Tell me how it plays out on Sunday.
note: A real reason because you're cutting in mid-flow, and a forward hook instead of a question.

situation: 友達と夜中までLINEしてて、もう寝たい。相手は恋愛の相談中で、まだ続きそうな雰囲気。
reply: 話してくれてありがとう。ちゃんと聞きたいのに、もう頭が回らなくなってきた。続きは明日の夜、電話で聞かせてもらってもいい？今日はおやすみ。
note: 重い話ほど「もう限界だから、ちゃんと聞ける時に」と正直に言うほうが、中途半端に返すより誠実です。

situation: Told a guy from a dating app I'm heading to bed after he'd been texting me for two hours. He replied 'wow ok, guess I'm boring you'. I do like him.
reply: Not a brush-off, I promise. I'm just done for the day and up at 6. Talk tomorrow.
note: Give warmth without retracting the exit, and don't end on a question that restarts the thread.

situation: 我妈每次打电话都能聊一个多小时，今晚我还得赶一个方案。想挂电话，又怕她觉得我嫌她烦。
reply: 妈，我得挂了，今晚还有个方案要赶出来。挂之前跟您说一声，周六我回家吃饭，想吃您做的红烧肉。好啦，您早点休息，拜拜。
note: 电话里先说要走，补一句最后的话，再说拜拜就挂，不用等她先挂，也不用反复道别。

situation: My ex, Sam, texted to congratulate me on my new job. We broke up 18 months ago on okay terms. We've been chatting for an hour and he's starting to suggest getting a drink. I don't want to meet up, but I don't want to be cold.
reply: Thanks, Sam, it was really nice to hear from you and I'm glad things are going well. I'm going to leave it here though, I don't think a drink is a good idea for me. Take care of yourself.
note: An ending without a future hook. Say no to the drink once, plainly, and don't close with a question that restarts it.

situation: Video call with a client, Martin. The agenda was done 15 minutes ago and he keeps telling stories about his sailing trip. I have another call at 3 and it's 2:52.
reply: Martin, I need to jump off in a couple of minutes for a 3 o'clock. Great session today, and I'll send the revised timeline by Thursday as agreed. Good luck with the race next month. Talk soon, bye.
note: A recap line signals the ending, the real reason is given because you're cutting in, and the last line is not a question.

situation: 儿子去年就不在那个少儿足球队踢了，但家长微信群还在，每天几十条消息。群里家长人都挺好的，想退群又不想显得突然。
reply: 各位家长好，乐乐已经不在队里踢球了，我就先退群啦。这两年谢谢大家的照顾，比赛日场边的加油声我们会一直记得。有事随时私信我，小区里碰到再聊！
note: 退群时一句真实原因加一句感谢就够了，不用多解释，最后一句不要用问句。

situation: I'm at an industry conference mixer and a software sales rep, Phil, has been pitching me for 20 minutes. I'm not interested, and I just saw my former colleague Ana walk in. How do I get out of this?
reply: Phil, I'm going to go catch Ana before she disappears, I've been hoping to see her all day. Thanks for walking me through it. Enjoy the rest of the conference.
note: In person: a true reason, a warm close, and no question at the end. If he asks to book a demo, one line: 'I'll pass for now, thanks.' Then go.

situation: Mein Nachbar Herr Becker (über 80, lebt allein) fängt mich fast jeden Abend im Treppenhaus ab und erzählt eine halbe Stunde. Ich mag ihn, aber heute habe ich schwere Einkaufstüten in der Hand, mit Tiefkühlsachen drin.
reply: Herr Becker, ich muss jetzt hoch, sonst tauen mir die Tiefkühlsachen weg. Schön, dass Ihr Knie wieder mitmacht. Am Samstag bringe ich Ihnen die Zeitung mit hoch, dann erzählen Sie mir den Rest. Einen schönen Abend!
note: Ein echter Grund, ein warmer Satz und ein fester Anknüpfungspunkt statt einer Frage. Redet er weiter: einmal kurz antworten, dann wirklich gehen.

situation: 周六在家请朋友吃饭，已经12点半了，老同学阿伟和他老婆还在沙发上聊，刚又开了一瓶酒。我们俩都累了，明天中午还要去我妈家吃饭。
reply: 今天真的太开心了，谢谢你们俩过来！我得收个尾了，我们俩有点撑不住，明天中午还要去我妈那儿吃饭。下次换你们家，我这就帮你们叫车。
note: 做主人也要自己收尾：先暖暖地总结一句，再给真实的理由，最后用一个具体动作（叫车）结束，而不是等对方领会暗示。

situation: I'm on a five-hour flight to Denver and the woman next to me, Linda, has been chatting for about an hour, mostly about her granddaughter's dance recital. She's lovely, but I need to sleep before a presentation first thing tomorrow. What do I say?
reply: It's been really nice chatting, Linda. I've got a presentation first thing tomorrow, so I'm going to put my headphones in and try to sleep for a bit. I hope the recital is wonderful.
note: When you can't physically leave, a warm recap plus a visible signal (headphones in) closes it; don't end on a question.

situation: A salesman from a solar panel company called my mobile and has been talking for five minutes about a free roof survey. I don't want one, and I'd rather they didn't call again. How do I get off the phone?
reply: Thanks, I'm going to stop you there. I'm not interested in a survey, and please take this number off your call list. Bye now.
note: A clean close with no hook: no reason to argue with, one request to be removed, then say bye and hang up without waiting for him to finish.
